data.description: A redcap wears heavy iron boots with spiked soles that it uses to deadly effect in combat.  These boots give the redcap a kick attack that it can make as a secondary attack, either as part of a full-attack action or as part of its movement just as if it had the Spring Attack feat.
data.name: Boot Stomp
